text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Now for the decisive moment!! How will 
they make their move from here?!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Right here!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Gran Alegria makes her move!! Gran 
Alegria—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I won't let you!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAAAARGH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Wh-what...?!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's Loves Only Youuu!! Loves Only You is 
surging forward!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
In the lead is Loves Only You!! Loves Only 
You crosses the line!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
This year, the cherry blossoms smiled upon 
love!! It's Loves Only You!!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —I... I did, it...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I won...!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Oooooh! Loves Only You is crazy strong~~!! 
The Tiara Umamusume are insane this year, 
too...!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Gran Alegria was amazing too, wasn't 
she...! I'm so looking forward to the 
Oaks...!!

text_block_list.name: Easily Bored Girl
text_block_list.text:
Oh gosh...! I can't stop crying...!! 
Loves-chan...! You've grown into someone 
truly magnificent...!

text_block_list.name: Community Members
text_block_list.text:
“SHE'S HEREーー!!” “YESSSSSS!!!” “Did you 
see Loves-chan's running?!” “CONGRATS!!!” 
“I'm so glad I'm alive” “THE ABSOLUTE 
BESTTTTT!”

text_block_list.name: Cheers
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: —Love-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Gran-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: First of all, congratulations!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: I want to say congrats, but―

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I'm sooo frustrated!!! I'm seriously, 
seriously, seriously frustrated!!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I should've had a great 130-mile run, 
too--!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Gran-chan...—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: (...Gran-chan hasn't noticed yet.)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(In today's race... To be blunt, I think I 
just got lucky.)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(Because every move the other runners made 
worked out perfectly for my race... while 
the exact opposite happened to Gran-chan.)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(If we raced again, I bet it wouldn't turn 
out like this. Out of ten races, I'd lose 
nine... That's just how terrifyingly 
strong Gran-chan was.)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(—Even so, I am the one who won today. 
It's a fact that fortune favored me and 
that I proved my honed love. So... I will 
face them with my head held high.)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: (Because that's my love for Gran-chan.)

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: —...I've decided!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: I'm not running in the Oaks anymore!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Because I lost at my own distance. At 
this rate, there's no way I can beat 
Love-chan at the Oaks...!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
More... more, more! I'll hone my mile to 
perfection!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
And this time for sure! I'm gonna beat 
Love-chan in the mile!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"...Gran-chan really is always Gran-chan, 
isn't she?"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(I won't be satisfied with just today's 
victory. I need to make my running even 
stronger...!)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I will take it on again, without fail. 
Gran-chan's mile, with my own running.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Yeah. It's a promise...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
――...Both Love-chan and Gran-chan far 
exceeded my expectations.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I need to hone it... more, and even more. 
My "Genesis Method"...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer-kun!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —Trainer-chan!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Mm...! These cherry blossoms bloomed from 
all our hard work...!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for bringing me here... 
Trainer-kun!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for bringing me here... 
Trainer-chan!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For your trainee to win a Classic race. 
For a Trainer, that is a glorious dream 
you simply cannot help but chase.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Loves Only You made that dream come true 
through running filled with love. As her 
trainer, nothing could make me happier.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu...♡ Then that means we've both 
devoted our love to each other.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Let's go! We have to show our community 
members what we're made of!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, standing side by side with Loves 
Only You, we basked in the roaring cheers 
celebrating her victory—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I swore in my heart... that I would bring 
this glory to Loves Only You once more.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...The 'Oaks' approaches quickly. As if 
it can hardly wait for the birth of a new 
Queen of the Oaks—"
